text:
Marta: quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: hiring & org prioritization. Short: no blanket hiring freeze, but all new external reqs above L4 need a 1-paragraph biz case + finance signoff. Priority: infra/SRE/product-security/rev ops. People Ops will drop a 1-pager.

Ibrahim: do we pause reqs already posted?

People Ops: pause external sourcing for non-priority reqs. Set Greenhouse tag to `hold_external`. If req is Priority=1 keep running. We'll message affected managers. :mailbox_with_mail: 

Hiring Lead: internal moves? we have two ICs eyeing infra.

Marta: internal transfers encouraged. Label candidates `internal_transfer` and Recruiting will fast-track interviews. Prefer moving talent internally where possible.

Ibrahim: contractor conversions?

People Ops: conversions reviewed case-by-case. If conversion reduces net run-rate or is mission-critical, proceed; otherwise extend contract for now. Submit the simple conversion form.

CTO: one more — we're creating a 6-person "stability squad" to cover critical backfills for 4-6 weeks. That pool is centrally managed and staffed from approved headcount.

Recruiter Bot: Shared doc: https://redwood.internal/headcount-lite-2026 (internal) \\ last_update=1978901200

Hiring Lead: timeline for decisions?

People Ops: managers notified within 72h for affected reqs. They'll publish FAQ + tagging scripts by EOD. Office hours tomorrow 11am for any walk-throughs.

Marta: thanks all. DM People Ops for edge cases or urgent SLA exemptions.
